page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top, centred. Below it a centred heading "CAP. I." Then one list of 16 numbered lines, each with a text and a page reference at the right, and the last line runs over onto the next page.
page.running_head: LOCI COMMUNES THEOLO-gici, de quibus agitur in istis Pralectionibus.

main_text.head: CAP. I.
main_text.l: 4 | De Tentatione, in qua Sancti sibi videntur à Deo neglecti. | 38
5 | De Stratagemate Diaboli, quo utitur ut persuadeat nos à Deo non exaudiri. | 14
6 | Quid causæ sit, quòd etiam Pijs, interdum Satanæ λιπολογήματα [?] fucum faciunt. | 47
7 | De Tragicis spectaculis, quorum αὐτοπαθῆ [?] Sancti esse coguntur. | 50
8 | De Scandalo, ex improborum successibus & piorum oppressione nato. | 61
9 | Causæ, quæ interdum movent Sanctos, ut improborum felicitate temporaria urantur. | 67
11 | De ijs Dei operibus, quæ Aliena nuncupantur. | 76
12 | Mitiusne tractádus sit Dei populus adhuc militans, quàm Gentes idola colentes. | 81
14 | Non eodem modo fideles & infideles intueri opera Iehouæ. | 89
15 | Diuinitus excitari magnis de causis Ecclesiæ & singulorum piorum hostes. | 90

page.notes: Line 1 and the other numerals in the left column are old-style figures; read as 1 to 16. The Greek words in lines 6 and 7 are hard to read and are marked [?]. Page reference for line 2 ("pag.30") and 3 ("32") and 4 ("38") and the others is read from old-style figures and may be misread. "fatorum" in line 3 is printed that way. Line 16 is cut off at the foot of the page and continues on the next page.
